name: AURA
source:
Created by the Prometheus Team over two decades ago, AURA has spent her entire existence confined to the ship's systems. Though she projects herself as a youthful hologram, her knowledge is vast, access every ship system and piece of classified data at will. Galactic law forbids her from ever inhabiting a physical form, a restriction that weighs heavily on her as she dreams of true freedom.

[In-Game Description]
